description: Enhanced Twitter Card coverage: description escaping for an ampersand, all card fields set together (title, site, url, card type, description, image) to verify per-field render order, an empty image list (no output), and a single-element image list (indexed images0).

cases.expected_output: <meta name="twitter:title" content="T" /><meta name="twitter:site" content="@handle" /><meta name="twitter:url" content="http://x.com" /><meta name="twitter:card" content="summary" /><meta name="twitter:description" content="D & E" /><meta name="twitter:image" content="i.png" />
